about: P47B T1 verb panel, holdout (read only by T12, once) half: 92 sentences written blind on 2026-10-15 by a subagent that saw only the five hero actions, their verb families and the genre list – no code, no lexicon, no other sentence set. Hand label `wants` (0–2 actions in sentence order), `family` = the family the sentence was written for (`trap` = looks like an action, wants none). Split by family with pure-rand xoroshiro128plus seed 4747, Fisher–Yates via uniformInt, first ceil(2n/3) of each family to dev.
